summary: Evotec SE filed a Form 6-K containing an ad hoc announcement of preliminary Q2 and H1 2026 financial results and a revised full-year 2026 outlook. No transaction, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or forced management change is disclosed. The filing is a routine earnings update with no special-situation event.
